meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the event is published
gaps: Open the QA mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor receives exactly one invitation email containing the event title, close time, and event link.
Verify that no other vendor receives the email and that no real supplier receives it.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA mailboxes and verify that each concerned vendor receives exactly one invitation email containing the event title, close time, and event link.; Verify that no other vendor receives the email and that no real supplier receives it.

steps.note: Open the event creation flow for the test event.
Give the event a known title that the tester can verify in the invitation email.
Apply the first available template so the event can be configured.
Add the required event line item.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Set and commit a close time that should appear in the invitation.
Invite the QA test vendors available to the test company without inventing supplier names.
Confirm the event was actually published before checking mail delivery.

args.need: open the QA mailboxes for the invited vendors and verify exactly one invitation email per concerned QA vendor with the event title, close time, and event link, while confirming no other vendor or real supplier received it

steps.note: Mailbox access and email delivery verification are not available in the catalog.
Retain a final assertion on the buyer-side publication result after the mailbox check.
